faq.title: Questions before the call
faq.subtitle: Short answers to what most clients ask first.

items.question: Where do I start if I'm not sure which service I need?
items.answer: Book the 30-minute call. The first job is a clear diagnosis, even if we do not end up working together.

items.question: How is pricing structured?
items.answer: Audits and the wireframing sprint are fixed price. Bespoke builds and migrations are quoted after the call; retainers are monthly.

items.question: Do you sign NDAs?
items.answer: Yes, before scoping. Bring your template or use mine.

items.question: Do you work outside Mexico?
items.answer: Yes. Operation is 100 % remote, with on-site sessions in CDMX or Estado de México when they add value.

items.question: Will I work directly with you?
items.answer: Yes, on every engagement. No junior handoffs, no account managers.

final.title: One call to find the right service line
